data.long_meaning: Mehetabel means 'loved by God' or 'beautiful in God' in Hebrew. In the Bible, Mehetabel is a name given to one of King David's wives. (1 Chronicles 3:9). The name Mehetabel carries the meaning “Beautiful in God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mehetabel usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful in god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehetabel total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mehetabel has its origins in ancient Hebrew culture and carries the significance of being loved or favored by God. It encourages individuals to live a life that reflects the love and grace of God, and to lean on His strength and guidance in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mehetabel, meaning "worshipper of God, foreigner," represents the spiritual journey of a follower who embraces her unique identity while staying devoted to her faith. This name embodies the courage to remain rooted in God, even when navigating unfamiliar territories.

biblical_reference.note: Mehetabel is mentioned in the Bible as the wife of Esau's son, Eliphaz.

historical_references.reference: Mehetabel is mentioned in the Bible as the name of a Moabite woman who married King David of Israel.
